final: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(product_quantity) <> '' GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS baseline_avg FROM order_averages) SELECT oa.order_id, oa.avg_quantity, oa.avg_quantity - b.baseline_avg AS difference FROM order_averages AS oa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
